meta.name: PM C14 - add CLOB settlement router
meta.description: proposeAddRouter(0x4cFA24dDf33c9e17c1f5e93EE90416AB801f8599) on PerpEngine — flags the engine's operator signer (KMS key, already the mainnet mark-writer and KYC writer) as a trusted router so CLOB fill settlement can call openPositionFor/closePositionFor and attribute positions to the trader instead of to the operator. READ safe-batch-C14-add-clob-settlement-router.md BEFORE SIGNING: the router flag lets this key name any trader and spend that trader's standing LPVault allowance. Execute now; starts 1h timelock.
